description: Ten signal paths, each with a button that silences it

params.text: Silences that row; click it again to let the signal through

inputs.text: The signal into that row; with nothing patched, the row takes the row above it, which makes the module a multiple with a mute per copy

outputs.text: That row's signal, at 0V while the row is muted

notes: a preset called Mute all ships with the module and turns on every row's mute; it is in the Preset submenu of the right-click menu
menu: Invert mutes — flips all ten buttons at once, so the muted rows play and the playing rows go silent
